title: Novig Referral Code SBWIRE Delivers $50 in Credit for NFL, NBA, NCAAF & More (Oct. 23)
text:
Novig Referral Code SBWIRE Delivers $50 in Credit for NFL, NBA, NCAAF & More (Oct. 23) PGA Tour LPGA College Amateur Golf Life Real Estate Equipment Apparel Newsletters SPORTS Novig Referral Code SBWIRE Delivers $50 in Credit for NFL, NBA & More
 Mark Strotman Oct. 23, 2026, 6:16 p.m. ET Here is a quick way to start trading sports: register at Novig with the Novig referral code SBWIRE , deposit $10 and receive $50 in trade credits. The money is divided into five $10 credits, which means one deposit can cover multiple trades.
 Novig lets you trade game contracts directly against other users, who set the prices. No sportsbook sits on the other side of your position. With football and the NBA in full swing and the World Series set, the Novig referral code gives new accounts extra funding for their first few picks.
 Below is a breakdown of how the offer works, how to claim it, where it is available and what to know before you start.
 Novig Referral Code SBWIRE Delivers $50 Bonus
 Detail Information 
 Novig Referral Code SBWIRE 
 Welcome Offer Deposit $10, get $50 in trade credits 
 How Credits Arrive Five separate $10 credits 
 Age Requirement 21 or older 
 Not Available In Arizona, Michigan, Nevada 
 Last Verified Oct. 23, 2026 
 Why 5 Credits Beat One Big Bonus
 Splitting the offer into five $10 credits gives you flexibility. Use one credit per game across five contests, or put several on a single slate. Each credit goes toward its own trade on a supported market. They are for trading only and cannot be cashed out.
 The setup also lets you learn as you go. Place one trade, see how pricing behaves, then decide how to use the credits that remain.
 Claiming the Novig Referral Code SBWIRE Offer
 Get the Novig app or open the website and create an account.
 Type in the Novig referral code SBWIRE when the sign-up screen asks for it.
 Confirm your identity and your location in an eligible state.
 Put $10 into your account.
 Check your balance for the five $10 credits and start trading.
 Add the code while registering. Referral codes usually cannot be applied once an account is open.
 How Novig Works
 Think of Novig as an exchange limited to sports. Contracts trade at prices that users determine, and winning contracts pay out. The CFTC regulates the platform, and it does not carry election or financial markets.
 Your Novig referral code credits can be used on supported markets such as NFL, college football and MLB. The app lists the terms for each credit, including expiration windows and order types, so give them a quick read before you trade.
 Before You Use the Novig Referral Code SBWIRE
 A little preparation helps. Complete identity verification as soon as you sign up, make sure you are in an eligible state and choose games you already follow. Those steps keep your first deposit and first trades running smoothly.
 Where Is the Novig Referral Code SBWIRE Valid?
 Most states are covered. People in Arizona, Michigan and Nevada cannot use Novig. Traders must be at least 21 and physically in an eligible state at the time of the trade.
 Novig Referral Code SBWIRE FAQs
 Which Code Should I Enter at Novig?
 Use SBWIRE . It qualifies new users for $50 in trade credits after a $10 deposit.
 What Does the $50 in Credits Look Like?
 It shows up as five $10 credits instead of one balance, and each credit can fund a separate trade.
 Are Trade Credits Withdrawable?
 No. They are meant for placing trades, not for cash withdrawals. See the in-app terms for details.
 Does Novig Cover Sports Other Than Football?
 Yes. Credits work on supported markets including NFL, college football and MLB, and Novig focuses only on sports.
 Can I Use the Novig Referral Code in Any State?
 No. Arizona, Michigan and Nevada are excluded, and you must be 21 or older.
